title: Coffee boiler temperature sensor
shortDescription: PT100 reading on coffee boiler is out of range.
fullDescription:
Er01 on La Marzocco GS3 and Linea Mini indicates the coffee boiler PT100 probe is open, shorted, or disconnected. The machine pauses heating until the probe is restored.

Usually a connector issue at the IO board.

fixSteps.title: Reseat probe connector
fixSteps.instruction: Remove side panel, reseat coffee PT100 plug at IO board.

title: Steam boiler temperature sensor
fullDescription: Er02 indicates the steam boiler PT100 probe is reading out of range.

title: Coffee boiler heating timeout
shortDescription: Coffee boiler did not reach setpoint.
fullDescription: Er03 means the coffee boiler heating element did not bring temperature to setpoint within timeout. Scaled element or failed SSR.

title: Steam boiler heating timeout
fullDescription: Er04 - steam boiler element didn't reach setpoint. Same root causes as Er03 for steam side.

title: Steam boiler autofill timeout
shortDescription: Autofill probe did not detect water within timeout.
fullDescription: Er05 indicates the autofill solenoid is energized but the level probe never confirms water. Empty supply, scaled probe, or failed solenoid.

faq.a: Both GS3 and Linea Mini support direct plumb.

title: Pressure transducer / pre-infusion fault
shortDescription: Brew pressure reading invalid during shot.
fullDescription: Er06 fires when the brew pressure transducer reports out-of-range during pre-infusion or extraction.

title: Steam boiler over-temperature
fullDescription: Er07 trips when steam boiler reaches dangerous temperature - usually a stuck SSR or scaled probe reading low.

title: Communication / Wi-Fi module fault
fullDescription: Er08 indicates the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module on GS3 or Linea Mini Connected variant is offline or unresponsive.

title: Pump pressure too low
shortDescription: Rotary pump not building expected pressure.
fullDescription: Er09 fires when brew pressure does not reach setpoint - failing rotary pump motor, slipping coupling, or bypass valve open.

title: Thermocouple / dual probe disagreement
shortDescription: Two boiler probes report mismatched temperatures.
fullDescription: Er10 fires on dual-probe boilers where the two PT100 readings disagree by more than 10C - likely scale or one probe failing.

fixSteps.title: Service inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Have technician verify both probes against reference.
